calls.reason: Musk's June 2025 post announced a plan to rewrite the corpus and retrain on it, but no record shows it was carried out. The Grokipedia audit shows a right-leaning tilt but doesn't connect it to Grok's training data. There is also no evidence the plan was dropped.

One study shows LLMs cluster politically, and PoliTune shows targeted fine-tuning can shift a model's ideology. Neither holds training data constant to measure how hard it is to differentiate a model, and neither measures accuracy costs. The evidence is too thin to call.
